about: Bhasha's own Bengali course, A1 to B2, written by Claude and reviewed by the owner. 'files' lists the unit files in course order. Each unit has its new 'words' (ro, en, fr, pos, note, and 'forms': inflected forms that give tap-hints and count as the word in sentences), 'extra' (names and places its sentences use without teaching them), 'lessons' (lists of its words; left out = groups of about 4) and 'sentences'. A sentence only appears once every word in it has been taught. 'rudeWords' are vulgar forms Wiktionary doesn't list.
